description: Runs the commerce application's original Server Actions, services and queue consumer against a disposable PostgreSQL database, one process per actor; the payment provider is a coordinator-hosted test double.

inviteMember.description: The exported Server Action withMember(inviteSchema, callback); the harness calls the action, the model checks the callback.

inviteSeat.description: The seat-invitation Server Action (UNIQUE(org_id, email) in the schema).

reserveItem.description: Read stock, check, write the new count.

reserveItemAtomic.description: Conditional decrement with a row-count check.

reserveItemLocked.description: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE inside a transaction.

checkout.description: Charge, then record the charge and mark the order paid.

checkoutIdempotent.description: The same checkout with the request id as idempotency key.

processRefundOnce.description: Queue consumer claiming the payout with a unique row first.

claimTask.description: Read the task, then mark it claimed.

claimTaskConditional.description: Conditional status update with a row-count check.
